messages:
Ava (docs): Pushed a small PR that updates SOC2-related wording for audit exports + adds a short 'retention examples' section. Link: https://git.redwood/repo/pulls/4821 — looking for quick tone & accuracy check, esp. around tenant data examples.
Miguel (security): Thanks. I skimmed — overall looks good but we should avoid implying we store tenant PII in exports by default. Suggest changing 'exports include full event payloads' -> 'exports include event metadata and any tenant-provided payloads; we recommend redaction as shown.'
Riley (legal): @Ava a couple legal nits: 1) don't use 'we delete after X days' — say 'data is retained for X days subject to legal hold' 2) for the TTL examples, add a line about customer-controlled retention vs. platform defaults.
Ava (docs): Good catches. I'll rework the sentence to "retained for 90 days by default; customers can configure a shorter TTL or request a legal hold". Is that okay?
Miguel (security): That phrasing is fine. Also add a short note about redaction: show a before/after export snippet and call out that fields labeled `sensitive` should be redacted server-side.
Devon (eng): For SDK snippet — we have a tiny change in the export API: param `include_full_payload` is now `payload_level: [minimal|full]`. Can you update the Python and curl examples? Here's the quick Python patch:
```
# new: choose payload_level
client.exports.create(tenant_id="t-123", payload_level="minimal", retention_ttl_days=30)
```
Nina (devex): I can take the snippet edits. One UX ask: please keep the short example first, then the long example. Users scan top-to-bottom.
Ava (docs): 👍 I'll reorder and include the redaction before/after. I'll push an updated commit in ~30m.
jenkins-bot: CI passed for PR #4821 — docs build OK (:white_check_mark:)
Riley (legal): One more micro-phrase: replace "customer can request deletion" with "customer can request deletion subject to export and legal hold procedures" — avoids implying immediate deletion.
Ava (docs): Will do. Thanks all — ping me if anything else.
Miguel (security): lgtm after small edits, ping when pushed. :thumbsup:
